mechanism: Both agents have immunosuppressive and skin-irritant properties; tazarotene's retinoid activity may enhance tacrolimus-induced photosensitivity and skin barrier disruption, potentially affecting dermal tacrolimus absorption and tolerability.
action: Monitor for increased skin irritation, erythema, and photosensitivity; consider spacing applications, using sun protection, and evaluating alternative topical retinoids if significant dermatologic adverse effects develop.
